title: react/react
claim: react/react — The library for web and native user interfaces.
why_good: React's extensive ecosystem and community support create opportunities for niche tools and services that enhance or extend its functionality.
value: Companies building applications with React may pay for premium plugins, consulting services, or performance optimization tools tailored to their specific needs.
risk: The market is saturated with similar libraries and tools, and larger companies could easily integrate these features into their existing products.
